messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident detected — routing policy anomaly causing region spillover

incident-bot: Alert ID INC-2026-0032
- symptom: elevated p99 latency for hosted endpoints in eu-west-1 starting ~2026-03-15T01:06Z
- observed: ~3-5% of eu traffic routed to us-east-1 fallback pool unexpectedly
- severity: high (customer-facing)

morgan: I'm on it. paging oncall @ana

ana: ack, looking. pulling routing + autoscaler logs for last 30m

kai: copying; do we have a quick mitigation? can we force strict-region policy temporarily?

ana: proposing to set routing.fallback_policy = 'regional-only' for eu-west to avoid us-east fallback. will attempt canary 1% first

morgan: +1 canary

elena: heads up CS — which customers affected?

cs_lina: saw spikes for tenants: acme, beta-co, nova-sim. I'll prep comms once we have mitigation and ETA

ana: sharing logs snippet: ```
2026-03-15T01:06:42Z [router] route decision: requested_region=eu-west model=rw-1.0 fallback=us-east reason=capacity_shortage
2026-03-15T01:07:01Z [kvs] kvcache miss for prefix: tenant=acme
2026-03-15T01:07:03Z [router] chosen backend: us-east-1-pool-3
```

ana: hypothesis H1: regional autoscaler failed to scale eu pool -> router used fallback. H2: fallback selector mistakenly allowed cross-tier routing (premium -> standard)

morgan: can we confirm pod counts / node health in eu-west at 01:06? kai?

kai: checking k8s events -> ```
NAME                       READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
inference-eu-1             0/2     Pending   0          4m
inference-eu-2             1/2     Running   0          12m
```

kai: looks like one pod pending, node unschedulable/tainted around 01:05Z

elena: any infra deploys to eu infra in last hour?

tony: no infra deploys, there was a model quant patch published at 00:58 but that only touched the model catalog, not infra nodes

ana: sharing trace IDs for affected requests -> ```
trace=01a3b9c def... tenant=acme request_id=rid-8f1 route=us-east-1-pool-3 fallback_policy=global
```

ana: mitigation plan: flip canary to 100% block cross-region fallback for eu-west (routing.fallback_policy -> regional-only). rollback plan: restore to 'global' if we see regression

morgan: do it; ensure monitoring dashboards + paging thresholds adjusted so we notice regressions quickly

kai: applied policy change at 01:12Z: ```
curl -X PATCH https://api.redwood.internal/v1/routing/policy -d '{"region":"eu-west","fallback":"regional-only"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
response: 200 OK
```

ana: metrics after change (01:14Z): p99 latency eu-west -> 210ms (was ~1200ms), error rate down ~83% vs peak

elena: CS notif sent to acme, beta-co, nova-sim with brief summary + workaround guidance

cs_lina: acme replied: degraded UX resolved for now, appreciate the quick response

ana: timeline note for RCA: primary suspect H1 = scheduler/autoscaler failing to provision pods (node unschedulable) causing regional capacity shortfall which triggered fallback. Secondary H2 = fallback selector ignoring tenant tier (allowed premium -> standard). Need deeper kube-scheduler, autoscaler logs and routing decision traces

morgan: can someone open an incidents tracker entry and assign RCA owner? I'll coordinate cross-team follow-ups

tony: I'll own the scheduler/autoscaler deep-dive (investigate node taint history, provisioning failures)

kai: I'll prepare a code change to add a guard in router that prohibits cross-region fallback for premium tenants (PR + test plan)

ana: hypothesis logstash: H1: node tainted -> pods pending -> regional pool under capacity -> correct fallback behavior; H2: router fallback selector bug ignoring tenant tier attributes; H3: rare: model quant update increased per-request memory/CPU leading to pod scheduling pressure (needs memory profiles)

ana: attaching links to logs/trace bundles in the incidents tracker (will paste after upload)

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0032 status updated -> mitigated (routing policy change) at 1772001870

morgan: switching to postmortem channel for RCA write-up and owners. Action items: (1) tony - scheduler RCA (2) kai - router guard + test (3) ana - add end-to-end traces and confirm tenant-tier enforcement in selector (4) cs_lina - customer follow-ups and impact spreadsheet. Please update tracker with time estimates. Great work team. :white_check_mark:
